title: Get a live SEO checklist while you write posts
summary: A marketer had Claude Code write two add-ons that tick off search-ranking checks and preview Google results as he writes blog posts.
agent_role: Claude Code suggested ideas and wrote the add-ons that react to its own actions; the author described what he wanted and picked which to build.
outcome: Author reports a live SEO scorecard and a Google preview strip working without writing code himself.
what_they_did: The author asked Claude Code to build small add-ons that run automatically when it does something. One checks whether the keyword is in the title, a heading and the first 100 words, and flags short posts. The other shows how the title and description will look in Google results.
how_it_went: He says both work in plain English with no code, and the checklist resets when he switches keywords.
worth_knowing: These add-ons have the same access to your computer as Claude Code. Test one in a single session first, and don't pile up ones you never use.
prompt: Build an add-on that runs automatically whenever you edit a blog post in [folder]. Check my target keyword [keyword]: is it in the title, a heading, and the first 100 words? Flag the post if it is under [word count] words. Also show how the title and description would look in Google results and warn if the title is cut off. Explain what the add-on can access before installing it, and wait for my approval.

curation.rationale: A real build: Claude Code wrote add-ons that show a live search-ranking checklist and a Google preview while writing. Light on evidence and ends with a sales-style call to DM.
